SHIPPING AND HANDLING (INTERNATIONAL):

If needed, please ask for a shipping quote first before ordering. International orders will be shipped via International First Class up to 32 ounces. International Priority Mail must be used for orders over 32 ounces. For International buyer's, please be aware of your country's custom fees, duties or taxes as you will be responsible for them. We will not falsify custom forms for any reason so please do not ask. We reserve the right to cancel your order should you ask us to falsify forms.  

SALES TAX: We are required by law to charge 10.5% sales tax on all orders shipping in Louisiana.

PLEASE NOTE: Orders are shipped every morning on Monday-Friday. Any orders paid after 6 am CST on Fridays will be shipped the following business day (Monday).

Insurance: Insurance is available at your request and expense. Please indicate in your order if you like insurance so that we can include it with your invoice. We are NOT responsible for lost or damaged packages that were not insured.

Shipping Address: Please make sure your address on Brinklink's Order Detail screen is CORRECT and COMPLETE as we will be using this address for shipping. If you have special instructions, please send a note on your order. Again, separate e-mails might be overlooked. If an incorrect address has been provided and the package is returned, you will be responsible for additional charges to have the package reshipped.
